Create a discrete (empty) ACSet with n parts in a given object

Source: R/structured_cospans.R
discrete_acset.Rd

The L functor: FinSet -> ACSet maps a finite set of size n to an ACSet with n parts in the interface object and nothing else.

Usage

discrete_acset(schema, ob, n)

Arguments

schema

BasicSchema

ob

Character: which object to populate

n

Integer: how many parts

Value

ACSet
